items.label: Versatile Design
items.value: Our cat litter box enclosure features a minimalist white finish combined with walnut accents, seamlessly integrating into various home styles, including living rooms, balconies, and bedroom corners

items.label: Dual-Purpose Functionality
items.value: This litter box furniture serves dual purposes, cleverly hiding the litter box for a tidy space while providing a secure, private resting nook for your beloved cat, ensuring both aesthetics and comfort

items.label: Spacious Storage
items.value: With dimensions of 31.3"L x 17.7"W x 17.3"H, this hidden litter box furniture accommodates most litter boxes easily, offering ample room for your cat to feel relaxed; the tabletop is ideal for displaying pet treats, photo frames, plants, or ornaments

items.label: Playful Cat Patterns
items.value: Two lively and cute cartoon cat patterns on the cabinet door add a touch of charm and fun to the furniture while enhancing the warm and joyful atmosphere of your home. This delightful detail makes daily use both pleasant and engaging

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: Designed with user-friendly assembly in mind, this cat litter box enclosure comes with clear instructions and all necessary parts, ensuring a simple setup process without complicated tools, allowing you to enjoy time with your cat in no time
